$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/bindings.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

mode.description: Supply mode (design 6.6): 'fetch' (default) fetches from the connector on every request; 'local' serves the features from an in-process table that 'bootstrap' loads in the background, with no I/O on the request path; 'cache' keeps what the connector returned in an in-process table (and optionally a distributed cache) for 'cache.ttl_ms'. Settings of another mode are errors.

connector.description: Modes fetch and cache, required: connector type and version, e.g. 'memory@1' (for cache, the origin the cache is in front of). Other members of the binding not listed here are the connector's own settings (e.g. 'data_file').

timeout_ms.description: Modes fetch and cache: time limit of one connector call, in milliseconds (default 50). For cache, the whole read of the keys a request misses (the distributed cache, then the connector) stays within it.

max_batch.description: Modes fetch and cache: maximum keys per connector call (default 1000); larger batches are split and sent concurrently. For cache, also the keys per read of the distributed cache.

lookup.description: Mode fetch: 'context' for sources organized by context key (design 6.5).

max_bytes.description: Modes local and cache, required: the most memory each table of the source (one per entity) may take, as an integer and a unit B, KiB, MiB, GiB or TiB, e.g. "512MiB". A local load that would exceed it fails and the plan is not served; a cache that reaches it drops its expired records, then its oldest.

bootstrap.description: Mode local, required: the update source that loads the table in the background, e.g. { "source": "snapshot_files@1", "uri": "fixtures/item_snapshot" }. A plan is served once every table it reads has completed its first load.

source.description: Required: update-source type and version, e.g. 'snapshot_files@1'. The other members are the source's own settings: for snapshot_files@1, 'uri' (the snapshot directory or its snapshot.json, relative to the config root) and optionally 'reload' (an ISO 8601 duration such as "PT1H").

cache.description: Mode cache, required: { "ttl_ms": 60000 }, optionally "stale_if_error_ms" and a "distributed" cache shared by the service's instances.

ttl_ms.description: Required: how long a value fetched from the connector is served, in milliseconds. Each key's lifetime varies by ±10% with the key's hash, so values written together do not all expire together.

stale_if_error_ms.description: How much longer (milliseconds, default 0) an expired value may be served when the connector fails or times out; its readers are then Degraded.

distributed.description: A cache shared by the service's instances, read on an in-process miss before the connector, e.g. { "store": "redis@1", "endpoint": "cache.internal:6379" }. Only an optimisation: when it fails or is slow, the keys go to the connector.

store.description: Required: store type and version, e.g. 'redis@1'. The other members are the store's own settings: for redis@1, 'endpoint' (host:port; for a cluster, any node), and optionally 'key_prefix' (default 'stratarec:'), 'user', 'password' (a secret:// reference), 'tls' (default false) and 'database' (default 0).

timeout_ms.description: The longest a request waits for one read of the distributed cache, in milliseconds (default: half the source's timeout_ms); always within the source's timeout_ms, so the connector keeps the rest of it.

client.description: Client type and version, e.g. grpc_tensor@1, memory_list@1, linear@1.
